# Larkfield API: staging environment (AWS eu-west-2)
# Copy to .env and fill in the placeholders. Never commit the real .env.

# HTTP port (optional, defaults to 3000)
PORT=3000

# Staging Postgres: host pg-stg-3.larkfield.internal, database larkfield_stg.
# The host is internal, so you need VPN/network access to reach it.
# Replace USER and PASSWORD with your staging credentials.
DATABASE_URL=postgres://USER:PASSWORD@pg-stg-3.larkfield.internal:5432/larkfield_stg
